reset.done: Your password was changed. You have been signed out everywhere; please sign in again.

weddings.title: Weddings
weddings.newSubtitle: Tasks and milestones are created from your template and scheduled backwards from the wedding date.
weddings.emptyBody: Create your first wedding to start planning.

fields.title: Title
fields.titleHint: Optional. Defaults to the couple's name.
fields.templateHint: Milestones and tasks to start with.

weddings.confirmDelete: Delete “{{title}}”? It moves to the trash for 30 days.
weddings.internalOnly: Internal – never shown to the couple

clients.title: Clients
clients.subtitle: Couples and enquiries, from first contact to the wedding.
clients.emptyBody: Add an enquiry or create a wedding to get started.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.subtitle: Your trusted photographers, florists, caterers and more.
vendors.emptyBody: Build your directory once and reuse it for every wedding.

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Reusable plans: milestones and tasks scheduled relative to the wedding date.
templates.confirmDelete: Delete the template “{{name}}”? Existing weddings keep their tasks.
templates.explainer: When a wedding is created from this template, each item's due date is calculated from the wedding date.

tasks.visibilityHint: New tasks are internal. Share a task to show it to the couple in their portal.
tasks.mySubtitle: Everything assigned to you, across all your weddings.
tasks.myEmptyBody: Tasks assigned to you in any wedding appear here.

warnings.over_budget: The forecast is {{amount}} above the total budget.
warnings.near_budget: Only {{amount}} left before the total budget is reached.

budget.footnote: Internal costs, internal notes and items marked internal are never shown to the couple. Every change to an amount is recorded in the audit log.
budget.visibilityHint: Visible items appear in the couple's budget, without internal cost and notes.

couple.title: Client portal
couple.hint: Invite the couple to follow their planning, tick off their tasks and see shared budget items.
couple.sent: Invitation sent. The link is valid for 7 days.

documents.fileHint: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text or images, up to {{max}} MB.
documents.tooLarge: This file is larger than {{max}} MB.
documents.titleHint: Optional. The file name is used if you leave it empty.
documents.shareHint: The couple can see and download it in their portal.
documents.confirmDelete: Delete this document and all its versions for good?
documents.emptyBody: Keep contracts, quotes, invoices and inspiration for this wedding in one place.
documents.footnote: Uploaded files are checked for viruses before they can be opened. Only this wedding's team, and the couple for shared documents, can download them.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.weddingIntro: Appointments for this wedding: tastings, fittings, meetings and more.
calendar.notesHint: Notes stay in the app; they are not included in calendar subscriptions.
calendar.shareHint: The couple sees it in their portal and calendar subscription.
calendar.endBeforeStart: The end time is before the start time.
calendar.emptyBody: Add tastings, fittings and meetings so the whole team knows what is coming up.

feed.title: Subscribe to your calendar
feed.intro: Add your weddings, appointments and your tasks to Apple Calendar, Google Calendar or Outlook. They update automatically.
feed.onceHint: Keep this link to yourself: anyone with it can see your calendar. It is shown only now.
feed.howApple: Apple Calendar: File → New Calendar Subscription, then paste the link.
feed.howGoogle: Google Calendar: Other calendars → + → From URL, then paste the link.
feed.howOutlook: Outlook: Add calendar → Subscribe from web, then paste the link.
feed.active: A subscription link is active since {{date}}.
feed.inactive: You have no subscription link yet.
feed.privacy: For your privacy the subscription contains titles, times and places only – no notes or amounts.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose which emails you get from {{organization}}. Emails tell you what happened and link to it; they never contain comment text or amounts.
notifications.coupleIntro: Choose which emails you get about your wedding.
notifications.privacy: Important account emails, like invitations and password resets, are always sent.

task_assigned.title: Tasks assigned to me
task_assigned.team: When someone gives you a task.
task_assigned.couple: When your planner gives you a task.

comments.couple: Replies from your planner on your tasks.

documents.title: Documents

documents.couple: When your planner shares a document with you.

daily_digest.couple: A short morning email when appointments or tasks for you are coming up.
